notes: v22 enemy (Hollow region): Archer, a watchful masked folk archer (ranged). Rigged from archer_prep_v2 (meshfix/prop_surgery.py + archer_cfg.json): Meshy modelled one arm lying across the chest with its fist on the arrow; it was replaced by two copies of it -- the bow arm from the -X shoulder to the grip knob where the stave crosses the arrow, the draw arm from the +X shoulder across the chest to the nock -- and the bow ripped free of the body. Arms are straight tubes in the template (elbow at mid-length). The bow (stave, flame-tipped arrow, string) is rigid in the bow fist; the string ramps to the draw hand at the nock so a draw pulls it into a V. Quiver rigid to the chest. Legs: wide pants, feet at x -0.21 / +0.32. Round 4 (producer: the bow arm joined the torso at the wrong place): the bow arm is rebuilt as the exact mirror image of the draw arm across the trunk mid-plane x=0.02 (meshfix post_mirror_x) and its chain is the mirrored draw-arm chain re-aimed at the bow grip: shoulder (-0.10,-0.08,0.80), symmetric with the draw arm's (0.14,-0.08,0.80). Round 5 (producer: the arm still joined the torso at the wrong place -- the mesh had no shoulders or upper arms): meshfix/archer_arms.py builds real arms (shoulder cap under the mantle, upper arm, bent elbow, forearm, the old fists as hands) joined watertight to the torso; the arm chains are its arms_report.json points (shoulder 2 cm inside the cap centre, elbow, wrist = the fist's wrist rim, hand tip = the fist's far end).
_prep: archer_prep_r5: prep_mesh.py --no-ground-sheet -> meshfix/prop_surgery.py (archer_cfg.json: Meshy bow tangle removed, fist shells) -> meshfix/archer_arms.py (archer_arms_cfg.json: real arms joined to the torso) -> meshfix/archer_bow.py (archer_bow_cfg.json: short pale D-shaped self bow + flaming arrow)
_placed_by: v22: placed by the writer from z/x/y mesh sections (coloured section tool), the calibrated views and the surgery's own arm transforms; checked with tools/lmcheck.py on archer_prep_v2. Spine at the section centres (pelvis z 0.45: 0.53/0.50 of the x/y extents; chest z 0.82: 0.49/0.55). Arms are straight template shells: shoulder->hand tip along each new arm's own axis, elbow at 0.42 and wrist at 0.64 of its length (collinear, so the hinge comes from the upper arm: arm_hinge_from_upper). lmcheck OUTSIDE by design: both toe tips (1.0/1.3 cm under the boot toe, snapped) and the bow hand tip (2.2 cm, the fist's end on the grip knob).

bow_rig._note: anim/bow_rig.py: rest placement from meshfix/archer_bow.py's bow_report.json; arrow_rest is native (normalised by the template like every landmark); drop.at is in NORMALISED rig/world units (KO: the bow lies flat on the floor at the Archer's left)

auto_clear._note: anim/bow_rig.py solve_clearance: per frame, the smallest bow cant (then yaw) change that clears the bow and arrow; dilated and smoothed

bow_rig._move_note: round 5: the Idle/Move hold's bow channels (= keyed.py _AR_BOW3Q), re-solved with the bow plane measured on the deformed bow: 38 deg off the battle camera, 31 deg off head-on
